mechanism: Captopril may reduce renal perfusion and glomerular filtration rate, potentially increasing sulfasalazine and its metabolite accumulation; sulfasalazine may impair captopril efficacy through salicylate-induced effects on renal function and sodium retention.
action: Monitor renal function, blood pressure control, and signs of sulfasalazine toxicity; adjust captopril dose if needed based on renal function; ensure adequate hydration.
